AT0108.title: AI Data Poisoning Tool
AT0108.description:
A toolset for constructing, injecting, and amplifying poisoned samples in AI training pipelines. These tools can generate samples with trigger conditions at scale, forge high-confidence data labels, rewrite public dataset records, or place poisoned content in web pages, documents, and data sources consumed by models so that models produce attacker-desired outputs in target scenarios.

In adversarial or black-market use, attackers combine crawlers, dataset upload interfaces, crowdsourcing workflows, open-model fine-tuning pipelines, and document synchronization processes to continuously inject poisoned samples. Legitimate red teams may use similar tools to validate training-data governance and pre-release model security testing.
